name: Bind
text: Roots one big enemy or boss for a few seconds.

name: Pseudopod
text: Extrudes long limbs for reach.

name: Hurl
text: Hurl: throw a loose object from the room (the rubble a broken wall leaves) at an enemy. Needs loose objects, and uses one up.

name: Maelstrom
note: The whirlpool draws foes in and hurts them; it does not pull loose parts of yours too.
text: A whirlpool that pulls enemies in.

name: Flood
note: It slows everything in a wide patch; it does not fill the room's low ground with swimmable water.
text: Floods the low ground for a while.

name: Dissolve
note: Skips armour and opens anything in the group `dissolvable`; the world's weak gates and grates arrive with the new areas (F2). It does not corrode your own held parts.
text: Eats through a weak gate, grate or armour plate.

name: Contagion
text: Poison jumps between enemies standing close.

name: Network
note: It slows enemies on a creeping patch; it does not show the shortest route to a mark.
text: A growth spreads along the floor and slows enemies on it.

name: Guardian
note: A patrol aura that hurts what comes near; it has no visible nail that drains you when hit.
text: A patrol aura that hurts what comes near.

name: Engulf
note: It stuns the enemy where it stands and digests it; the enemy is not drawn inside the body.
text: Swallows a small enemy and holds it while it digests.

name: Ride
note: A plain glide: the fall slows for a moment; no cloud is drawn and it does not carry you sideways.
text: A short glide on a cloud.

name: Recall
note: The first cast lays a mark; the second puts you back on it in one step, not along a walked trail.
text: Lay a trail, then return along it to its start.

name: Shed
text: Leave a husk that draws the enemies near it and slip away. The husk is gone until you rest.

name: Court
text: Court: three lesser slimes fight for you for ten seconds. Each dies to a single touch.

name: Stalk
note: A stack of one-way steps appears at once; it is not a vine you hold, and it does not grow slowly.
text: Grow a climbable vine from the floor.

name: Transmute
note: Moves three of the most held first-pass element into two of the least held; there is no element chooser, it never makes fire, mind or blood, and it does not digest parts faster.
text: Convert held essence of one element into another at a loss.

name: Copy
note: Takes the last appraised creature's attack and defence for eight seconds; its shape and one of its moves wait for the creature kits (F1).
text: Take the shape and one move of the last creature you inspected, for a short time.

name: Rise
text: Stand on two legs for claws (+2 ATK, +1 DEF); cast again to drop to four and gallop. Rising costs a beat, and you cannot pounce while up.

name: Frenzy
text: Frenzy: each kill stokes a bloodlust meter (faster, harder, bleeding bites). At full you cannot stop. No guard and no items while frenzied.

name: Stalk-kill
text: Stalk, then kill: the first cast hides you; the next lunges for four times the damage. A crowd of three or more sees you and spoils it. You shrug off hits from afar.

name: First Wolf's roar
text: First Wolf's roar: every wild wolf in the room fights for you for eight seconds. A boss is not turned.

name: Skin
text: You choose the change: a berserk window with no flinch and iron-proof. A crash follows it.

name: Shield-bite
text: A bite that breaks guards and opens the berserk window; each kill refills it. It still crashes when it ends.

name: Chaser
text: A gallop nothing slows. Mark an enemy running away: the pounce that catches it is free.

name: Slink
text: A silent gait: unseen until you strike or are struck. A lit room shows you almost at once.

name: Fear howl
text: A howl that sends the enemies around you running; you cannot pounce while you howl.

name: Burning pounce
note: A fire lunge; it leaves no flame trail and it does not hurt a packmate.
text: A burning pounce and a flame trail.

name: Omen
text: Mark one enemy to die in ten seconds unless it cleanses (deep water, holy light). One mark at a time; a boss is only wounded.

name: Spectral pack
text: Spectral pack: two echoes that pounce whenever you do, and fade after eight seconds.

name: Hunt's passage
note: A long glide that needs no kill first; no pack carries you.
text: The pack carries you over one gap (a short glide).

name: Three barks
text: Three barks: two warnings that wake what is near and hold you still, then a lunge that cannot be dodged from range and hits three times as hard.

name: Bond
text: Bond: a packmate that lasts, and for twelve seconds a heavier pounce that shoves what it hits.

name: Tank
text: A shove that stuns and knocks down heavy targets. You cannot be shoved.

name: Unbound
note: Breaks armour and anything in the group dissolvable; the world's barriers and grates arrive with the new areas (F2).
text: Breaks barriers and grates (a gate-breaking verb).

name: Lone hunter
text: Lone hunter: strongest with no packmate, and prey with no company takes double. The bond is disabled.

name: Guardian
text: Guardian: plant holy ground that wards your packmate and keeps you unharmed and mended while you stand on it. You cannot stray far from it.

name: Opener
note: Shows nodes in the group hidden; the world's hidden exits and shortcuts arrive with the new areas (F2).
text: Reveals hidden exits and shortcuts in a room.

name: Suckle
text: Suckle: mend your packmates; the third time, a pup grows into a second packmate.

name: Devour
text: Devour the nearest corpse to heal; with none, a slow, heavy swing.

name: Rend
text: A claw with a paralysing touch (even a heavy creature goes down) that leaves a stench cloud where you stand.

name: Drain
text: A bite that heals you by half of what it deals. Fast, and frail to holy light.

name: Hop
text: Hop: three bounding leaps in a straight line that you cannot turn, draining on touch. A talisman stops it.

name: Heft
text: A huge swing, slow to land. For twenty seconds each kill swells you: +1 ATK for the life, up to five.

name: Barrow slam
text: A ground-pound shockwave that stuns. You take a point less from every hit for each part you carry, up to four.

name: Cleaver
text: A heavy cleaver swing. Your stitched body wears two more grafts, and the stench slows what comes close.

name: Overhead cleave
text: A slow overhead cleave, then you hold your shield up: half damage for a moment.

name: Vengeance
text: A heavy swing that hits two and a half times harder against the creature that killed your last life.

name: Herald
text: Herald: a long whip, and every second cast a thrown head that flies out and comes back. No shield.

name: Juggernaut
text: A stomp that stuns everything around you. Poison clouds and thrown spears do nothing to you.

name: Sow
text: Shield wall: a spear thrust, a raised shield (seven tenths of physical damage blocked for three seconds) and two bone soldiers sown. You are rooted while you sow.

name: Squad
text: A squad of four sown soldiers for ten seconds. Each dies to a touch.

name: Rise
text: Rise: downed enemies stand up as dancers for ten seconds. Only works near bodies.

name: Bone throw
text: Bone throw: a bone that flies out and returns to your hand, hitting twice. A bow-arm graft stretches its reach.

name: Sure shot
text: Six sure shots, then a cursed seventh that hits three times as hard and costs you 4 HP.

name: Life-arrow
text: Life-arrow: spend all but one of your HP on one arrow that crosses the room and pierces, worth two damage for each HP spent.

name: Mark
text: Mark: the first cast marks the nearest prey; the next arrows home on it from twice as far, whichever way you face. One mark at a time.

name: Lure-light
text: A drifting light that enemies follow, off ledges and into anything underfoot. It shows where you are.

name: Trick
text: Place a lure: enemies near it come to it, and the first to touch it is held fast.

name: Wail
text: A wail that stuns and frightens everything in front; it also wakes every sleeper within earshot.

name: Minions
text: Minions: two bone minions, a third and harder-hitting with a focus carried or worn. Frail.

name: Bone beams
text: Bone beams that bounce between enemies, and a blink back from what is in front. A phylactery shard in your remains keeps them from wearing away.

name: Hidden soul
text: Hidden soul: place an anchor; if you would die within reach of it you rise there at full health, once per life. An enemy that stays at the anchor destroys it.

name: Float
text: Float: the skull hangs in the air, falling not at all, for six seconds. Very strong, and the frailest form.

name: Consecrate
text: Consecrate: a ring of light that mends you and your summons and burns the living (not the undead). You absolve, you do not drain; your dark powers are weak.

name: Wrap
text: Bandages bind enemies; a sand gust.

name: Decree
text: Decree: a curse marks everything in the room (half again as much damage for ten seconds) and two tomb guards rise.

name: Weigh
text: Weigh: if the creature's essence is lower than what you hold, drain it at once. Against a stronger one the scales tip and nothing happens.

name: Hands
text: Hands: raise a person's torso to use items and tools (+2 ATK); cast again with them up to shoot a bow. Without hands up you cannot use items.

name: Veil
text: Pass as a goblin: goblins do not see you, others do. Being hit or attacking bursts the veil, and you cannot web while it lasts.

name: Sisters
text: Sisters: split into seven decoys that draw the enemies near and web what they strike. Each dies in one hit.

name: True form
text: True form: burrow a lair (a moment underground, untouchable and unseen), then rise as a giant and call two lesser spiders. Needs room to grow.

name: Tapestry
note: A patch of web that slows for twelve seconds; it does not catch and hold.
text: Weave a patterned web that stays as a trap and a snare.

name: Fate thread
text: Tie a thread to an enemy: the next hit it lands on you goes back to it.

name: Steal
note: Takes the last appraised creature's attack and defence for ten seconds; stealing a power or essence waits for the creature kits (F1).
text: Take a power or essence from a living enemy without killing it.

name: Brood
text: Brood: each cocoon you carry hatches two spiderlings that harass your enemies and carry loose parts to you. With no cocoon, nothing hatches.

name: Command
text: Command: four spiderlings that follow your lead: they go for whatever you struck last.

name: Hatch
text: Hatch: the prey you cocooned hatches into stronger young, after a time (two for each cocoon, hitting half again as hard).

name: Disperse
text: The body breaks into a swarm that squeezes through grates and reforms. A swarm cannot fight.

name: Heavy bite
text: A slow, heavy bite, and a wall of web spun ahead that holds each enemy crossing it.

name: Drink
note: Heals HP and MP; no lamp or pool is eaten and no room darkens.
text: Eat lamps and glow pools to darken a room and heal.

name: Span
note: A plank of web laid ahead for fifteen seconds; it is not permanent and needs no anchors.
text: Spin a permanent web bridge across a gap (a traversal gate).

name: Ambush
text: Ambush: from the ceiling, drop on what is below for two and a half times the damage. In a lit room the blow is weak.

name: Silent drop
text: A silent drop with a bonus strike in dim light: double in the dark, weak in a lit room.

name: Reset
text: Hunt the dark: faster, and unseen while you stand in shadow. Each kill resets the zip. A lit room gives you away.

name: Veil
text: Spin a web over a doorway: whoever stands in it is unseen. Any attack tears it.

name: Venom web
note: A web patch that slows and poisons what is in it; the poison does not spread through trap webs.
text: Webs apply poison that spreads through trap webs.

name: Miasma
note: A poison cloud for eight seconds; it does not spread when you die.
text: A poison cloud that spreads on death.

name: Dance-venom
text: A poisonous bite that jumps to a second enemy; each bitten enemy staggers about, erratically and off ledges, once the venom takes hold.

name: Offer
text: Offer: give a carried part to a weakened creature (or a stunned one) and it follows you.

name: Tune
text: Tune: a pipe call brings three followers and draws every rat near you to your side. You cannot throw while you play.

name: Knot
text: Knot: a swarm of tamed vermin that acts as one big companion, striking everything close to it. It stays one companion.

name: Lull
text: Calms the hostile creatures around you so they stop attacking and can be tamed; a boss ignores it.

name: Mount
text: Mount: fuse with your companion for a ride, faster and harder. The companion takes the blows meant for you, and is lost if it falls.

name: Spear charge
text: Spear charge: twice the damage with a companion to ride, and little on foot.

name: Two companions
text: Two companions at once, the capstone's exception to one at a time. They are fragile.

name: Rig
note: One kind of trap, a spring that hurts and stuns; crafted throwables and recipe slots wait for the item wheel.
text: Rig a trap that hurts and stuns the first enemy to step on it.

name: Tap
note: Shows nodes in the group hidden; hidden walls, weak floors and traps arrive with the new areas (F2).
text: Senses hidden walls, weak floors and traps in a room.

name: Sabotage
text: Jam the nearest enemy's verb and throwing, and turn its spears, globs and puffs against it. Sometimes it backfires and jams you.

name: Spin
note: Moves essence between elements at a loss; junk and parts are not modeled.
text: Transmute junk into a better part, two for one.

name: Forge
note: A portable forge: two carried parts become a lasting +2 ATK for the life; forges in the village rooms come with F2.
text: Forge a named weapon from two carried parts: a lasting +2 ATK.

name: Flawless gear
text: Forge flawless gear from three carried parts: a lasting +3 ATK in one slot and +2 DEF in a second.

name: Cursed gear
text: Cursed gear: huge attack for a while, and a curse that stays for the life (-2 max HP each time).

name: Sneak strike
text: A sneak strike that hits harder out of hiding, then a smoke bomb that hides you.

name: Dye
text: Dye the cap: speed and damage while it is wet. Each kill refreshes it; if it dries you lose it for a long while.

name: Stomp
text: A heavy kick with heft: a slow stomp that stuns everything around you.

name: Cap-throw
text: Cap-throw: a boomerang cap, dyed with a blood essence you spend, that returns through everything it hit and hits half again as hard.

name: Mislead
text: Leave a decoy that draws the enemies near it and turns them about, and slip away.

name: Swap
text: The first cast leaves a decoy that looks like the nearest creature and draws enemies; the second trades places with it after a beat.

name: Pocket
text: A short teleport ahead that picks the pocket of the living creature you land beside.

name: Ward
text: Ward: plant a stone that protects an area: nothing hurts you or your companions inside it.

name: Hearth
text: Hearth: plant a ward-stone. Enemies near it are slowed and you mend while you stand by it. Two stand at a time.

name: Lar
text: Lar: ward-stones close together link into one wider, stronger aura. Planting one holds you still a moment.

name: Fear aura
text: Curse-stone: enemies near it flee. Your own allies fear you there too.

name: Blessed throw
text: Blessed throw: a holy throw, and your shield goes up behind it: two fifths of all damage blocked for a moment.

name: Horn
text: Horn: a blast that stuns and rallies your allies and companions to strike faster and harder. It is loud: it wakes everything near.

name: Giant-slayer
text: A blow whose damage scales with the target's size: strong against giants, weak against small foes.
